name: taskhive
description: TaskHive: a multi-tenant MERN project and task portal

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
